name: Eli Bailey
source:
Eli is a supermodel and key to open Lauren's future. He is elegant, charming and the owner of the most viewed social media pages.

When it's about work, Eli is the best man to have around. He gives his best to reach success and never back down. He also knows how to please people and, consequently, how to take advantage of it.

Well-known by fashionistas and famous people, Eli brings all the trouble in Lauren's life when he shows up proposing to her to join him in the worst challenge of her life.

He likes to have everything under his control and hates it when people disobey him.
